mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the previous month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent market declines.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous two months signals a weakening in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST decrease > 5% does not correlate with subsequent market declines.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous two months signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with subsequent market gains.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent market declines.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the previous month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of PAYEMS and UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent market gains.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the previous month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decrease > 1% does not correlate with subsequent market declines.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% for two consecutive quarters and industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 0.5% in the last month, it signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 2% for 2 quarters and INDPRO decrease > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of GDPC1 and INDPRO does not correlate with subsequent market declines.
